visual_logic.color_palette: Dark silt-grey with brilliant 'Jarositic' yellow racing stripes along the spine.
visual_logic.environment: Hazy dark-grey water with long, horizontal underwater sunbeams cutting straight across the wide frame to establish a clear tracking line and diffused yellow light shafts with floating sediment.
visual_logic.pose: A full-body horizontal profile view stretching completely from the left edge to the right edge of the frame. The massive, 12-to-13-meter long body is aligned perfectly flat in the upper half of the image, keeping the bottom half clear so a second species can easily be drawn or stacked directly beneath it for side-by-side length comparison. Rather than bending its neck into an extreme S-curve or playful 'U' shape, its long neck and tail extend out straight and horizontal along the tracking line to showcase its maximum scale.
